claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CGP-7930 is a GABAB receptor positive allosteric modulator with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: CGP-7930 is a GABAB receptor positive allosteric modulator with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
